By email, and through a Google Form

content_sections.heading: About TISS
content_sections.text: TISS is located at V.N. Purav Marg, Deonar, Mumbai, and is declared a Deemed to be University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956. Prayas, the project behind this recruitment, is a field action project of its Centre for Criminology and Justice, initiated in 1990. It responds to the needs of disadvantaged groups who come in contact with the Criminal Justice System. It aims to facilitate the socio-legal and economic rehabilitation of persons at risk of criminalisation, exploitation in commercial sex, and those living in destitute conditions.

content_sections.heading: TISS Female Social Worker Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The post is unreserved, but candidates from reserved categories can also apply.

rows.pay: Rs. 30,000 per month (including field work allowance)

content_sections.heading: TISS Female Social Worker Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Gender: Female candidates only. Age limit: The upper age limit is 40 years. Qualification: Master's Degree in Social Work (MSW). Experience: Minimum three years of experience in social work practice in the field of criminal justice. Fluency in Marathi, Hindi and English. Good written communication skills in English, Marathi and Hindi. Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team. Familiarity with MS Office, email and Internet applications. Knowledge of government schemes, rules and regulations, and the ability to establish relevant institutional linkages. The Institute reserves the right to relax qualification and working conditions based on a candidate's work experience. It may also relax age for persons already holding comparable positions in a University/Research Institution of repute. The official notification (PDF) has the discipline-specific eligibility details for this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications may be shortlisted. Shortlisted candidates are informed over e-mail and/or phone. They then appear for the Written Test/Interview, which may be offline or online. Holding the prescribed qualifications and experience does not by itself entitle a person to an interview call. The Institute also reserves the right to invite persons who may not have applied through this procedure, and it may choose not to fill the vacancy.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Nature of appointment: On contract basis, initially for a period of 01 year. Place of posting: Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar Central Prison, Aurangabad District, Maharashtra. Joining: The selected candidate has to join within 15 days of intimation of selection.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TISS Female Social Worker Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare your updated resume and copies of your educational qualification and experience certificates. Email them to [email protected] . Fill out the TISS Prayas Google Form as well.

faq.question: Q1. Can male candidates apply for this TISS Social Worker post?
faq.answer: No. The work is in a women's prison where male staff are not permitted under prison rules, so only female candidates are eligible.

faq.question: Q2. Is sending the email enough to apply?
faq.answer: No. Candidates must also fill out the Google Form, as applications submitted without it may not be considered for selection.

faq.question: Q3. Which documents go with the application email?
faq.answer: Send your updated resume with copies of your educational qualification and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q4. What kind of experience does the post require?
faq.answer: The notice asks for a minimum of three years in social work practice in the field of criminal justice.

faq.question: Q5. Can reserved category candidates apply?
faq.answer: Yes. The single post is unreserved, but candidates belonging to a reserved category can apply for it.

faq.question: Q6. Does the Rs. 30,000 salary include field work allowance?
faq.answer: Yes. The monthly amount of Rs. 30,000 is inclusive of the field work allowance.

faq.question: Q7. Will TISS pay travel costs for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA is payable for appearing for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. How soon must the selected candidate join?
faq.answer: The selected candidate has to join within 15 days of being told of the selection.
